spec.description: A simulated campus grid over the photogrammetric 3D Tiles mesh of AGI HQ in Exton: overhead lines that sag between their poles, with comets by load, and the field of view of every security camera on the parking lots.

options.content:
### A campus grid and its security cameras, over the photogrammetric mesh

The **AGI headquarters** in Exton, Pennsylvania, as a 3D Tiles mesh surveyed from the air, with a **simulated** distribution grid strung over its roads and security cameras watching its parking lots. The roads and the lots come from OpenStreetMap; the poles, the loads and the cameras are made up.

- **Overhead lines**: a 13.2 kV feeder on Valley Creek Boulevard, four laterals into the parking lots and a 480 V service circuit, 76 poles in all. Each conductor hangs between its poles; the comets run with the amps and the colour is the share of the line's rating in use.
- **Security cameras**: 44 on 6 m poles around the parking lots and 12 domes on the building corners, each drawn as its field of view: the lens's angle, as far as it sees, fading away from the camera. The colour is motion in the last hour: green quiet, orange busy, red very busy, grey offline.

**Ctrl + drag** to rotate and tilt. **Needs internet**: the mesh comes from a public bucket and takes around 300 MB of GPU memory at close range.

spec.rawSql:
-- Simulated: a 110° dome camera on each corner of the three buildings, 14 m
-- up at the roof edge, looking out along the corner's diagonal over the lots
-- and walkways around it, 35 m out.
-- Motion events per hour follow the day at Exton: arrivals around 8, departures
-- around 17, a trickle at night. About one camera in twenty is offline, picked
-- by a hash of its id so it holds between refreshes; it reads -1 and draws grey.
WITH camera(camera, area, model, azimuth, beamwidth, range_m, latitude, longitude) AS (VALUES
  ('CAM-01', 'Building 1', 'dome 4K, 110°', 354, 110, 35, 40.0391071, -75.5975267),
  ('CAM-02', 'Building 1', 'dome 4K, 110°', 308, 110, 35, 40.0389619, -75.597867),
  ('CAM-03', 'Building 1', 'dome 4K, 110°', 127, 110, 35, 40.038492, -75.5970748),
  ('CAM-04', 'Building 1', 'dome 4K, 110°', 174, 110, 35, 40.0383383, -75.5974207),
  ('CAM-05', 'Building 2', 'dome 4K, 110°', 33, 110, 35, 40.038886, -75.596362),
  ('CAM-06', 'Building 2', 'dome 4K, 110°', 89, 110, 35, 40.0385998, -75.5961499),
  ('CAM-07', 'Building 2', 'dome 4K, 110°', 270, 110, 35, 40.0385955, -75.5970649),
  ('CAM-08', 'Building 2', 'dome 4K, 110°', 212, 110, 35, 40.0383008, -75.5968417),
  ('CAM-09', 'Building 3', 'dome 4K, 110°', 34, 110, 35, 40.0396455, -75.5968818),
  ('CAM-10', 'Building 3', 'dome 4K, 110°', 88, 110, 35, 40.0393721, -75.5966921),
  ('CAM-11', 'Building 3', 'dome 4K, 110°', 268, 110, 35, 40.0393508, -75.5975793),
  ('CAM-12', 'Building 3', 'dome 4K, 110°', 214, 110, 35, 40.0390774, -75.5973896)
),
clock AS (SELECT (epoch(now()) / 3600 - 4) % 24 AS hour, epoch(now()) / 60 AS minute),
s AS (SELECT camera.*, hash(camera) % 100 AS draw, hour, minute FROM camera, clock)
SELECT camera, area, model,
       CASE WHEN draw < 5 THEN 'offline' ELSE 'online' END AS status,
       CASE WHEN draw < 5 THEN -1
            ELSE greatest(1, round((1 + draw % 4)
                       * (0.6 + 9 * exp(-((hour - 8) ^ 2) / 1.5) + 7 * exp(-((hour - 17) ^ 2) / 2)
                          + 2 * (hour BETWEEN 9 AND 16)::INTEGER)
                       * (1 + 0.3 * sin(minute / 5 + draw))))::INTEGER END AS events_1h,
       azimuth, beamwidth, range_m, latitude, longitude
FROM s
ORDER BY camera
